# What will winning this lot actually cost you, out the door?

> Free calculator for farm and heavy-equipment auction bidders: turns a hammer price into the true out-the-door total, including a capped buyer's premium, online-bidding premium, card surcharge, and sales tax — then works backward to a max bid for your budget. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
